meta.title: Tell us what you want to build · {brand}
meta.description: Answer three quick questions and see the demos that fit your business, or talk to us on WhatsApp.

common.serverError: Something went wrong. Please try again, or talk to us on WhatsApp.
common.rateLimited: You have sent several requests in a short time. Please try again in an hour.

type.title: What do you want to build?
type.hint: Pick the closest one. You can explain more in the next step.

business.label: A website for my business
business.hint: Get more customers, bookings and trust online.

system.label: A custom system for my business
system.hint: Dashboards and tools that save your team time.

saas.label: A SaaS product
saas.hint: Software you sell to many customers.

other.label: Something else
other.hint: Not sure yet? Tell us and we will guide you.

details.businessTitle: What kind of business do you have?
details.ideaHint: A few lines are enough: what it does and who it is for.
details.ideaError: Write at least 10 characters so we understand you (up to 1000).

contact.title: How can we reach you?
contact.hint: We reply on WhatsApp, usually within a few hours.
contact.whatsappHint: With the country code, for example +966 50 000 0000
contact.whatsappError: Enter a valid number: 8 to 15 digits, with an optional + at the start.
contact.emailError: Enter a valid email, or leave it empty.

result.demosFallbackTitle: We build for your field too
result.demosFallbackText: We have no demo for your field yet, but we build for it. Meanwhile, try our other demos.
result.ideaText: We will read it and reply to you on WhatsApp. You can also message us now.
